access.description: Permissions for processes to access subtrees.

auth_factors.description: How to unlock the database when credentials are accessed. These form a tree via references.

data_path.description: A directory where this will store sqlite databases.

lock_timeout.description: Lock if no successful activity for this many seconds.

root_factor.description: Which factor forms the root of the tree (provides the database key).

ui.description: How to run the `passworth-ui` helper that shows unlock and prompt windows.

pin.description: If pinentry, this must be null and will use the entered pin.  If not pinentry, either uses the config-specified pin or no pin.

fixed_pin.description: If true, use the pin preconfigured for each smartcard instead of showing pinentry.

smartcards.description: List of cards that can be used.

match_binary.description: Match requesting processes against the process or a parent process binary path. This only applies to binaries available in the root filesystem namespace.

match_tag.description: Match requesting processes against a tag name (via passworth-tag) and tagging user.

match_user.description: Match requesting processes against the process or a parent process owner.

paths.description: Paths to which this rule applies. In the format `/seg/seg/.../seg`. To apply to everything, use the empty path `""` - no initial slash. Segments are literals or `*`. `*` is a wildcard, and must appear as a whole segment. `*` and `/` can be escaped with a backslash.

permit.description: Permission to explicitly lock or unlock.

ConfigUi.description: The GTK user interface runs in a separate helper process (`passworth-ui`) which never sees the database or derived keys, only what the user types.

binary.description: Path to the `passworth-ui` binary. Defaults to `passworth-ui` next to the server binary.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the helper, e.g. `WAYLAND_DISPLAY`. The server's own environment is passed through as well.

user.description: Run the helper as this user (requires the server to run as root). `HOME` is set from passwd and `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` to `/run/user/UID` unless overridden in `env`. Recommended when the server runs as root and the desktop session does not.

MatchBinary.description: Match a single process running a specific binary. Note that this will match interpreters for scripts, not the script being run (even if the script is run directly via shebang).

first_arg_path.description: The first argument (excluding argument 0, the exe itself) is a path that's present in the root filesystem, the argument.

path.description: The absolute path of an executable to match.

walk_ancestors.description: Sufficient if any ancestor up to this number of steps away from the process doing IPC matches (excluding the process itself). Defaults to 0.

MatchTag.description: Match a single process or ancestor with both a tag set by `passworth-tag` and a specific user id.

tag.description: The target or ancestor must have this tag.

user.description: The target or ancestor must have this owner user.

walk_ancestors.description: Sufficient if any ancestor up to this number of steps away from the process doing IPC matches (excluding the process itself). Defaults to 0.

MatchUser.description: Match a single process run as a specific user and/or group.

group.description: The target or ancestor must have this owner group.

user.description: The target or ancestor must have this owner user.

walk_ancestors.description: Sufficient if any ancestor up to this number of steps away from the process doing IPC matches (excluding the process itself). Defaults to 0.

PermitLevel.description: Actions permitted by a rule. Later levels include all prior levels.

oneOf.description: Use the contents of values without directly revealing the value:generate signatures, decryption, totp generation, etc.
Lock and unlock the password store
Retrieve json keys but not values, public keys derived from stored private keys.
